## Rules

- Never include passwords, tokens, secrets, raw database URLs, or unnecessary customer PII.
- Every S0/S1 must have an owner and immediate next action.
- Resolved S0/S1 requires explicit retest evidence before beta continuation/expansion.
- Accepted-risk items must state the accountable decision and launch impact.
